instruction.text: Match the sentence types with their definitions.

a.sound: These are the most common types of sentences. They mostly end with a full stop.
These are sentences that show surprise or strong feelings. They end with an exclamation mark.
These are sentences that ask something. They end with a question mark.
These are sentences that tell someone to do something. They end with a full stop or an exclamation mark.

instruction.text: Select the correct end punctuation to make the sentence a command.

atoms.a: Always look before you cross the road!
atoms.b: Always look before you cross the road((? ++! ++.))

instruction.text: Select the correct end punctuation to make the sentence a statement.

atoms.a: The weather has been bad this past week.
atoms.b: The weather has been bad this past week((? ! ++.))

instruction.text: Select the correct end punctuation to make the sentence a question.

atoms.a: When was the last time you red a book?
atoms.b: When was the last time you read a book((++? ! .))

instruction.text: Select the correct end punctuation to make the sentence an exclamation.

atoms.a: What a fantastic cricketer he is!
atoms.b: What a fantastic cricketer he is((? ++! .))
